topic: Handling duration formatting and object cloning
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered two main technical topics. First, the difficulty of formatting small time durations (e.g., 'a few seconds') in a human-readable format; it was decided that custom logic would be implemented to display minutes and seconds for all intervals.

Second, the challenge of correctly cloning complex JavaScript objects when using shared templates across multiple graphs. Solutions discussed included `_.deepClone` or similar methods from libraries like Lodash, as simple object copying fails when dealing with nested structures or array references.
decisions: Implement custom logic to display minutes:seconds for all duration intervals.
action_items: Research alternative methods for deep object cloning in JavaScript.
